title: The Sealed Book
paragraphs: A mystery and horror anthology in which the Keeper of the Book opens a sealed volume to reveal standalone tales of murder, greed, revenge, and the supernatural.

Mystery/horror anthology with Phillip Clarke as The Keeper of the Book. The frozen GRH container contains all 26 numbered broadcasts plus two modern reference tracks. Program-number evidence corrects two frozen dates additively and documented Mysterious Traveler same-script relationships are retained.
GRH documents the program through 26-program Mutual run (March 18, 1945 to September 9, 1945) on [[org|org.09b709d4bde5c263|Mutual Broadcasting System]].

Among the most extensively documented contributors in the GRH holdings are David Kogan (writer on 26 recordings, producer on 2 recordings, and director on 1 recording), Jock MacGregor (director on 26 recordings and producer on 26 recordings), Robert A. Arthur (writer on 26 recordings and producer on 1 recording), Phillip Clarke (host on 25 recordings), Carl Caruso (announcer on 1 recording), Carl Emory (performer on 1 recording), and Don Randolph (performer on 1 recording).
The program is also connected in the archive to [[org|org.09b709d4bde5c263|Mutual Broadcasting System]] (broadcast on network) and [[org|org.666407112636e085|Michelson]] (syndicated by).

Its indexed subjects and listening characteristics include mystery and suspense, death, murder and mortal danger, fate, foreknowledge and doom, houses, rooms and domestic danger, ghosts and supernatural threat, and identity, faces and the past.

GRH also places the series in documented historical contexts including Mutual mystery anthology, Keeper of the Book framing device, Script reuse with The Mysterious Traveler, and Reference tracks alongside historical broadcasts.
